title: Independently audit BIT COPY support propagation at the retained caller
body:
PR4200's seven-rank COPY floor uses a support-propagation implication: a branch with private-frame intersection L can affect target p only if L lies in its final cap. This answers its explicit independent-review handoff with a separately written paired-execution proof and exact caller-premise checks.

The proof isolates branch-injected influence while retaining arbitrary correlated public dirt and the same fixed trace. Every dependency must preserve `L⊆U ⇒ L⊆W`; upward public MOVEs and common-frame ADDs suffice. This is a sufficient local condition, not a necessity claim for every whole trace with dead/cancelling edges. Linearity/unchanged-q and private closure are separated from the causal lemma. Downward-MOVE and unequal-frame-ADD controls deliberately leave the predecessor model; they are not predecessor bugs.

Evidence:

- Exact original 38,927-record frame trace, 636 rational span ranks, 111 cap equalities and 6,470 orthogonality checks. Public suffix: 1,699 records = 760 upward MOVEs + 939 same-frame ADDs, with unchanged nine sources and no COPY.
- Separate finite closure: 283 states / 1,780 transitions; code-disjoint oracle: 34,208 symbolic states / 317,824 transitions / 1,632 closed walks, arbitrary dirty columns and cancellation controls.
- Independent Fraction cross-check of 636 ranks / 2,904 MOVE differences / 111 caps. Six normal/strict-optimized registered commands pass locally and from exact committed Git-free bytes. Source-byte and declared-source ancestry checks pass.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-copy-support-audit --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-copy-support-audit
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-copy-support-audit --check-source-history
```

Canonical base `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority 7. Handoff-first assignment `coverage-law-change`, explicitly changed from the generic complex ceiling card to this named BIT proof audit; [claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4199#discussioncomment-19074339). Pinned predecessor PR4200 `ddfc3133cbdf548e163c867d5671f8f01dd5d5ae`; 320 open/draft bodies and current hub/canonical thread checked, with broader closed/code/Discussion coverage partial. New PR4204 paired endpoints and PR4205 rational FFT are distinct; Ross Richardson's active mixed-total construction is excluded. Minimal untouched exports are retained in this PR's own source commit `2c2b29438773f12b3bb5903723c3bb16f0dcd583`, preserving cold availability and original attribution.

This does not rerun R/K or recipient/projected-recipient ranks, all 660 scalar endpoint columns, full root closures, physical MOVE semantics, complete invoice, precision or the outer theorem. The original seven-rank floor/projection argument remains Ross Richardson's PR4200 work. Source credit: Ali Romman, Sagar Thakrar, DreamingOfClouds/eumemic/PR589/PR555 and retained NOTICE lineage; historical direct-decoder floor credit remains Russell Seligmann/PR757 and Cody Harris/PR761 following Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled/PR620.

Prepared for ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate proof, oracle and review agents; no human/formal-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0. No new supplier or κ, merge or selected-frontier change. Maintainer edits disabled. Concrete open next questions and remaining obligations are in README/TASK.json.
